abstract: U.S. agriculture is vital to meeting a growing global population’s demand for food, fiber, feed, and fuel. Smart technologies, big data, and improvements in crop genetics present producers with promising new opportunities for meeting these needs. However, a changing climate and an expanding global population impose challenges to increasing crop and livestock production while sustaining the natural resource base and protecting environmental quality. Sustainable agricultural development will call for systems approaches to allocate land among competing uses, coupled with the adoption of conservation technologies incentivized by cost‐effective policies that have been based on evidence from sound economic, behavioral, biological, and technological research. This paper suggests directions for future research in nine key dimensions that can fill important gaps in the existing literature and build on new research methods and policy needs, as well as inform strategies for sustainable growth of agriculture.
abstract_zh: 美国农业对于满足不断增长的全球人口对食物、纤维、饲料和燃料的需求至关重要。智能技术、大数据以及作物遗传学的进步，为生产者满足这些需求提供了新的机遇。然而，气候变化和全球人口扩张给增加作物和畜禽产量带来了挑战，同时也威胁着自然资源基础和环境质量的保护。可持续农业发展需要采用系统方法在相互竞争的用途之间配置土地，并辅以由具有成本效益的政策所激励的保护技术的采纳，而这些政策应基于经济、行为、生物和技术研究所提供的可靠证据。本文提出了九个关键维度的未来研究方向，这些方向可以填补现有文献中的重要空白，并建立在新的研究方法和政策需求之上，同时为农业的可持续增长战略提供参考。

abstract: Renewable energy policies in the electricity and transportation sectors in the United States are expected to create demand for biomass and food crops (corn) that could divert land from food crop production. We develop a dynamic, open‐economy, price‐endogenous multi‐market model of the US agricultural, electricity and transportation sectors to endogenously determine the quantity and mix of bioenergy likely to be required to meet the state Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPSs) and the federal Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) if implemented independently or jointly (RFS & RPS) over the 2007–2030 period and their implications for the extent and spatial pattern of diversion of land from other uses for biomass feedstock production. We find that the demand for biomass ranges from 100 million metric tons (MMT) under the RPS alone to 310 MMT under the RFS & RPS; 70% of the biomass in the latter case can be met by crop and forest residues, while the rest can be met by devoting 3% of cropland to energy crop production with 80% of this being marginal land. Our findings show significant potential to meet current renewable energy goals by expanding high‐yielding energy crop production on marginal land and using residues without conflicting with food crop production.
abstract_zh: 美国电力和交通部门的可再生能源政策，预计将创造对生物质和粮食作物（玉米）的需求，这可能使土地从粮食作物生产中被转移出去。我们构建了一个动态、开放经济、价格内生的多市场模型，涵盖美国农业、电力和交通部门，以内生地确定在独立或联合实施（RFS与RPS）各州可再生能源组合标准（RPS）和联邦可再生燃料标准（RFS）时，满足其要求所需的生物能源数量及构成，考察期为2007–2030年，并分析其对生物质原料生产中其他用途土地的占用程度及空间格局的影响。我们发现，生物质需求量从仅实施RPS时的1亿公吨（MMT）到同时实施RFS与RPS时的3.1亿公吨不等；在后一种情况下，70%的生物质可由作物和森林残余物满足，其余部分则可通过将3%的耕地用于能源作物种植来满足，其中80%为边际土地。我们的研究结果表明，通过在边际土地上扩大高产能源作物种植并利用残余物，在不与粮食作物生产相冲突的前提下，实现当前可再生能源目标具有显著潜力。

title: Effectiveness of the Biomass Crop Assistance Program: Roles of Behavioral Factors, Credit Constraint, and Program Design 39 (4), 584-608, 2017
abstract: The Biomass Crop Assistance Program (BCAP) aims to incentivize the production of biomass for bioenergy and bioproducts. This paper investigates the potential effectiveness of BCAP in stimulating biomass production. We find that the effectiveness of BCAP is significantly affected by program design, farmers’ risk and time preferences, credit availability, and biomass prices. The impact of a budget‐constrained BCAP on incentivizing biomass production is much larger under a program design that enrolls land with the largest incremental biomass production per BCAP payment dollar (IBP‐Max design) than under a design that enrolls land with the lowest cost of production (COP‐Min design). The effectiveness of BCAP in inducing biomass production is highest when farmers are credit constrained, have a high degree of risk aversion, and a high rate of time preference under the IBP‐Max design. The mix of feedstocks induced by the BCAP also varies as the biomass price increases; at low prices much of the biomass induced is from crop residues, while at high prices it is from perennial energy crops. The additional biomass production induced by the BCAP ranges from 0.1% to 62% of total biomass production without BCAP under the IBP‐Max design, and from 0.1% to 3% under the COP‐Min design. However, the volume of biomass production induced by BCAP is small even in the credit constrained, high‐risk aversion, and high discount rate scenario (2.7 million metric tons annually) due to the limited program budget of $125 million BCAP budget under the 2014 Farm Bill.
abstract_zh: 生物质作物援助计划（BCAP）旨在激励生物能源和生物产品的生物质生产。本文考察了BCAP在刺激生物质生产方面的潜在有效性。我们发现，BCAP的有效性受项目设计、农民的风险与时间偏好、信贷可得性以及生物质价格的显著影响。在预算约束下，采用“每美元BCAP支付所带来的增量生物质产量最大化”设计（IBP-Max设计）时，BCAP对激励生物质生产的效果远大于采用“生产成本最低”的土地纳入设计（COP-Min设计）。在IBP-Max设计下，当农民受信贷约束、风险厌恶程度高且时间偏好率高时，BCAP诱导生物质生产的效果最强。随着生物质价格上升，BCAP所诱导的原料构成也随之变化：在低价格下，所诱导的生物质大部分来自作物残余物；在高价格下，则来自多年生能源作物。在IBP-Max设计下，BCAP诱导的额外生物质产量占无BCAP情形下总产量的0.1%至62%；在COP-Min设计下，该比例为0.1%至3%。然而，即便在信贷受限、风险厌恶程度高和贴现率高的情景下，BCAP诱导的生物质产量仍然很小（每年270万公吨），这是由于2014年《农业法案》规定的BCAP预算仅有1.25亿美元，较为有限。

title: Inducing Pollution Prevention Adoption: Effectiveness of the 33/50 Voluntary Environmental Program
venue: Journal of Environmental Planning and Management
abstract: The Environmental Protection Agency has encouraged voluntary efforts at pollution prevention by facilities through participation in voluntary environmental programs (VEPs) such as the 33/50 program to reduce toxic releases. This paper examines the effectiveness of the 33/50 program in the adoption of pollution prevention practices and disentangles the effect of adoption from that of program participation on releases of 33/50 chemicals. Using facility-specific panel data and controlling for the endogeneity of program participation and pollution prevention adoption, we find that program participants were 38% more likely to adopt pollution prevention practices than non-participants. Program participants who adopted pollution prevention practices reduced their 33/50 releases by 52% compared to facilities that neither participated nor adopted pollution prevention. This indicates that VEPs that emphasize pollution prevention can play a complementary role in reducing toxic releases.
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）鼓励设施通过参与自愿环境项目（VEP）开展自愿性污染预防，例如旨在减少有毒物排放的33/50计划。本文考察了33/50计划在推动污染预防措施采纳方面的有效性，并厘清了采纳措施本身与参与项目对33/50化学物质排放的影响。利用设施层面的面板数据，并控制项目参与和污染预防措施采纳的内生性，我们发现，参与项目的设施采纳污染预防措施的可能性比未参与的设施高38%。采纳污染预防措施的项目参与者，其33/50排放量比既未参与也未采纳的设施减少了52%。这表明，强调污染预防的自愿环境项目可以在减少有毒物排放方面发挥补充作用。

title: Is Forest Bioenergy Carbon Neutral or Worse than Coal? Implications of Carbon Accounting Methods
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: The carbon benefits from forest bioenergy have been controversial with some environmental groups and scientists considering it to be even worse than coal while others contend that its use can lead to substantial savings in emissions relative to coal. Studies assessing the GHG implications of forest bioenergy differ in the source of emissions (biogenic or life-cycle) that they are accounting for, the metric used for this accounting, the spatial scale at which these emissions are measured, the time frame over which they are measured, and the counter-factual baseline to which emissions with the use of forest bioenergy are compared. This paper discusses the implications of these underlying differences. It shows that the spatial and temporal scales for assessment, and the extent to which market feedback effects and behavioral responses are incorporated, play a critical role in the widely different assessments obtained by these studies.
abstract_zh: 森林生物能源的碳效益一直存在争议：一些环保团体和科学家认为其甚至比煤炭更糟，而另一些人则主张，使用森林生物能源可以相对煤炭大幅节省排放。评估森林生物能源温室气体影响的研究，在以下方面存在差异：所计入的排放来源（生物源排放还是全生命周期排放）、所采用的核算指标、排放测算的空间尺度、测算的时间范围，以及用于比较的反事实基准。本文讨论了这些差异的影响。研究表明，评估所采用的空间和时间尺度，以及市场反馈效应和行为反应被纳入的程度，在这些研究得出的差异很大的评估结果中起着关键作用。

title: Motivations to Grow Energy Crops: The Role of Crop and Contract Attributes
abstract: Perennial energy crops are a promising source of bioenergy whose production involves production risks, long‐term commitment of land and need for crop‐specific investments without the coverage of crop insurance potentially available for conventional crops. We conduct a choice experiment in five states in the Midwestern and South‐central regions of the U.S. to examine the effect of crop‐contract attributes on the joint discrete‐continuous choice decisions to adopt an energy crop and convert acres to it from a status quo use, while controlling for the effect of various farmers’ risk and time preferences, sociodemographic characteristics, and availability of crop insurance for conventional crops. We find robust evidence that high discount rates, high upfront establishment costs and need for crop‐specific investments create disincentives for adoption and allocation of land to energy crop production. The effects of riskiness of returns and risk aversion are less robust across specifications. The effect of conventional crop insurance on the energy crop adoption decision differs across types of insurance; in particular, farmers with revenue insurance are statistically significantly less likely to adopt an energy crop. Our results have implications for the design of effective contracts and policy incentives to induce the production of energy crops.
abstract_zh: 多年生能源作物是一种很有前景的生物能源来源，但其生产涉及生产风险、土地的长期承诺，以及对特定作物的投资需求，而且可能无法享受传统作物所能获得的作物保险保障。我们在美国中西部和中南部地区的五个州开展了一项选择实验，考察作物合约属性对农户在联合离散–连续选择决策中的影响，这些决策包括是否采用能源作物以及是否将原有用途的土地转为能源作物种植。同时，我们还控制了农户的各种风险与时间偏好、社会人口特征以及传统作物保险的可得性。我们发现，高贴现率、较高的前期建立成本以及对特定作物投资的需求，会对能源作物的采纳和土地配置产生抑制作用。收益风险和风险厌恶的影响在不同设定下稳健性较弱。传统作物保险对能源作物采纳决策的影响因保险类型而异；特别是，拥有收入保险的农户采纳能源作物的可能性在统计上显著更低。我们的结果对设计有效的合约和政策激励，以促进能源作物生产，具有启示意义。

title: The Social Inefficiency of Regulating Indirect Land Use Change due to Biofuels
abstract: Efforts to reduce the indirect land use change (ILUC) -related carbon emissions caused by biofuels has led to inclusion of an ILUC factor as a part of the carbon intensity of biofuels in a Low Carbon Fuel Standard. While previous research has provided varying estimates of this ILUC factor, there has been no research examining the economic effects and additional carbon savings from including this factor in implementing a Low Carbon Fuel Standard. Here we show that inclusion of an ILUC factor in a national Low Carbon Fuel Standard led to additional abatement of cumulative emissions over 2007–2027 by 1.3 to 2.6% (0.6–1.1 billion mega-grams carbon-dioxide-equivalent (Mg CO2e−1) compared to those without an ILUC factor, depending on the ILUC factors utilized. The welfare cost to the US of this additional abatement ranged from $61 to $187 Mg CO2e−1 and was substantially greater than the social cost of carbon of $50 Mg CO2e−1.
abstract_zh: 为减少生物燃料引起的间接土地利用变化（ILUC）相关碳排放，低碳燃料标准已将ILUC因子纳入生物燃料的碳强度之中。尽管以往研究对该ILUC因子给出了不同的估计，但尚无研究考察在实施低碳燃料标准时纳入该因子所产生的经济影响及额外的碳减排效果。本文发现，在全国性低碳燃料标准中纳入ILUC因子，使2007–2027年的累计排放额外减少了1.3%至2.6%（即6亿至11亿兆克二氧化碳当量，Mg CO2e−1），相较于不含ILUC因子的情形，具体取决于所采用的ILUC因子。美国为这一额外减排所付出的福利成本为每Mg CO2e−1 61至187美元，且显著高于每Mg CO2e−1 50美元的碳的社会成本。

Carbon Savings with Transatlantic Trade in Pellets: Accounting for Market-Driven Effects
abstract: Exports of pellets from the United States (US) are growing significantly to meet the demand for renewable energy in the European Union. This transatlantic trade in pellets has raised questions about the greenhouse gas (GHG) intensity of these pellets and their effects on conventional forest product markets in the US. This paper examines the GHG intensity of pellets exported from the US using either forest biomass only or forest and agricultural biomass combined. We develop an integrated dynamic, price-endogenous, partial equilibrium model of the forestry, agricultural, and transportation sectors in the US to investigate not only the direct life-cycle GHG intensity of pellets but also the accompanying indirect market and land use effects induced by changes in prices of forest and agricultural products over the 2007–2032 period. Across different scenarios of high and low pellet demand that can be met with either forest biomass only or with forest and agricultural biomass, we find that the GHG intensity of pellet based electricity is 74% to 85% lower than that of coal-based electricity. We also find that the GHG intensity of pellets produced using agricultural and forest biomass is 28% to 34% lower than that of pellets produced using forest biomass only. GHG effects due to induced direct and indirect changes in forest carbon stock caused by changes in harvest rotations, changes in land use and in conventional wood production account for 11% to 26% of the overall GHG intensity of pellets produced from forest biomass only; these effects are negative with the use of forest and agricultural biomass.
abstract_zh: 美国木质颗粒出口正在快速增长，以满足欧盟的可再生能源需求。这种跨大西洋的颗粒贸易引发了关于这些颗粒的温室气体（GHG）强度，以及其对美国传统林产品市场影响的疑问。本文考察了仅使用森林生物质或同时使用森林与农业生物质所生产的美国出口颗粒的温室气体强度。我们构建了一个涵盖美国林业、农业和交通运输部门的综合性动态、价格内生的局部均衡模型，不仅考察颗粒的直接全生命周期温室气体强度，还考察在2007–2032年期间，由森林和农产品价格变化所引发的间接市场效应与土地利用效应。在高、低两种颗粒需求情景下（这些需求可由仅使用森林生物质或森林与农业生物质共同满足），我们发现，颗粒发电的温室气体强度比煤电低74%至85%。我们还发现，利用农业和森林生物质生产的颗粒，其温室气体强度比仅利用森林生物质生产的颗粒低28%至34%。由于采伐轮作期、土地利用及常规木材生产的变化，森林碳储量直接和间接变化所产生的温室气体效应，占仅利用森林生物质生产颗粒的总温室气体强度的11%至26%；而在同时使用森林与农业生物质的情况下，这些效应为负。

title: Cost of Abating Greenhouse Gas Emissions with Cellulosic Ethanol. Environmental Science and Technology
abstract: We develop an integrated framework to determine and compare greenhouse gas (GHG) intensities and production costs of cellulosic ethanol derived from corn stover, switchgrass, and miscanthus grown on high and low quality soils for three representative counties in the Eastern United States. This information is critical for assessing the cost-effectiveness of utilizing cellulosic ethanol for mitigating GHG emissions and designing appropriate policy incentives to support cellulosic ethanol production nationwide. We find considerable variations in the GHG intensities and production costs of ethanol across feedstocks and locations mostly due to differences in yields and soil characteristics. As compared to gasoline, the GHG savings from miscanthus-based ethanol ranged between 130% and 156% whereas that from switchgrass ranged between 97% and 135%. The corresponding range for GHG savings with corn stover was 57% to 95% and marginally below the threshold of at least 60% for biofuels classified as cellulosic biofuels under the Renewable Fuels Standard. Estimates of the costs of producing ethanol relative to gasoline imply an abatement cost of at least $48 Mg(-1) of GHG emissions (carbon dioxide equivalent) abated and can be used to infer the minimum carbon tax rate needed to induce consumption of cellulosic ethanol.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个综合框架，用以确定并比较在美国东部三个代表性县的高质量与低质量土壤上，由玉米秸秆、柳枝稷和芒草生产的纤维素乙醇的温室气体强度与生产成本。这些信息对于评估利用纤维素乙醇减缓温室气体排放的成本效益，以及设计支持全国纤维素乙醇生产的恰当政策激励，至关重要。我们发现，乙醇的温室气体强度和生产成本在不同原料和地点之间差异显著，这主要源于产量和土壤特征的不同。与汽油相比，芒草乙醇的温室气体减排幅度为130%至156%，柳枝稷为97%至135%。玉米秸秆的相应范围为57%至95%，略低于《可再生燃料标准》中将纤维素生物燃料认定为至少减排60%的门槛。生产乙醇相对于汽油的成本估算表明，每减排一吨（以二氧化碳当量计）温室气体的减排成本至少为每Mg 48美元，并可用于推断促使消费纤维素乙醇所需的最低碳税税率。

title: Impacts of Management Practices on Bioenergy Feedstock Yield and Economic Feasibility on Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) Grasslands
abstract: Perennial grass mixtures planted on Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) land are a potential source of dedicated bioenergy feedstock. Long‐term nitrogen (N) and harvest management are critical factors for maximizing biomass yield while maintaining the longevity of grass stands. A six‐year farm‐scale study was conducted to understand the impact of weather variability on biomass yield, determine optimal N fertilization and harvest timing management practices for sustainable biomass production, and estimate economic viability at six CRP sites in the United States. Precipitation during the growing season was a critical factor for annual biomass production across all regions, and annual biomass production was severely reduced when growing season precipitation was below 50% of average. The N rate of 112 kg ha−1 produced the highest biomass yield at each location. Harvest timing resulting in the highest biomass yield was site‐specific and was a factor of predominant grass type, seasonal precipitation, and the number of harvests taken per year. The use of N fertilizer for yield enhancement unambiguously increased the cost of biomass regardless of the harvest timing for all six sites. The breakeven price of biomass at the farmgate ranged from $37 to $311 Mg−1 depending on the rate of N application, timing of harvesting, and location when foregone opportunity costs were not considered. Breakeven prices ranged from $69 to $526 Mg−1 when the loss of CRP land rental payments was included as an opportunity cost. Annual cost of the CRP to the federal government could be reduced by over 8% in the states included in this study; however, this would require the biomass price to be much higher than in the case where the landowner receives the CRP land rent. This field research demonstrated the importance of long‐term, farm‐scale research for accurate estimation of biomass feedstock production and economic viability from perennial grasslands.
abstract_zh: 种植在保护性储备计划（CRP）土地上的多年生禾草混合物，是专用生物能源原料的潜在来源。长期的氮肥施用和收获管理，是在保持草地寿命的同时最大化生物质产量的关键因素。我们开展了一项为期六年的农场规模研究，以了解天气变化对生物质产量的影响，确定可持续生物质生产的最佳施氮量和收获时机管理措施，并估算美国六个CRP试验点的经济可行性。在所有地区，生长季降水都是决定年度生物质产量的关键因素，当生长季降水低于平均水平的50%时，年度生物质产量会严重下降。在每个地点，每公顷112千克（112 kg ha−1）的施氮量产量最高。产量最高的收获时机因地点而异，取决于主要草种、季节性降水以及每年的收获次数。在所有六个地点，无论收获时机如何，使用氮肥提高产量都明显增加了生物质成本。在不计入放弃机会成本的情况下，农场门口的生物质盈亏平衡价格为每Mg干物质37至311美元，具体取决于施氮量、收获时机和地点。若将放弃的CRP土地租金支付计为机会成本，盈亏平衡价格则为每Mg干物质69至526美元。在本研究所涵盖的各州，联邦政府的年度CRP成本可降低8%以上；然而，这需要生物质价格远高于土地所有者获得CRP土地租金时的水平。这项田间研究表明，长期的农场规模研究对于准确估算多年生草地的生物质原料产量和经济可行性十分重要。

title: Managing Multiple Mandates: A System of Systems Model to Analyze Strategies for Producing Cellulosic Ethanol and Reducing Riverine Nitrate Loads in the Upper Mississippi River Basin
Mix of First and Second Generation Biofuels to meet Multiple Environmental Objectives: Implications for Policy at a Watershed Scale
abstract: Biofuel mandates are being widely used by countries to achieve multiple objectives of energy security and climate change mitigation. The Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) in the US specifies arbitrarily chosen volumetric targets for different types of biofuels in the US based on their greenhouse gas intensity only. Cellulosic biofuels from high yielding energy crops like miscanthus have the potential to co-generate multiple environmental impacts, including reducing nitrate runoff, being a sink for Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions and providing a given volume of biofuel with less diversion of land from food crop production than corn ethanol, but at a significantly higher cost. This paper quantifies the tradeoffs between profitability, food and fuel production, GHG emissions and nitrate runoff reduction with different types of biofuels in the Sangamon watershed in Illinois and analyzes the optimal mix of biofuels as well as the policies that should supplement the mandate to achieve multiple environmental outcomes. We find that a two-thirds share of cellulosic biofuel in the mandated level could reduce nitrate run-off by 20% while reducing GHG emissions by 88–100% but would reduce profits by 15–27% depending on whether a GHG policy or a Nitrate policy is used relative to the case where the mandate is met by corn ethanol alone. Additionally, the ratio of corn stover to miscanthus used to produce cellulosic biofuels is higher under a GHG policy compared to a Nitrate policy that achieves the same level of nitrate reduction. Our results show that the optimal mix of different types of biofuels and the policy to induce it depend on the environmental objectives and the tradeoffs that society is willing to make between low cost energy security, food production and various environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 各国普遍采用生物燃料强制配比政策，以实现能源安全和减缓气候变化的多重目标。美国《可再生燃料标准》（RFS）仅依据温室气体强度，为不同类型的生物燃料设定了任意选定的体积目标。来自芒草等高产能源作物的纤维素生物燃料，具有共同产生多种环境效益的潜力，包括减少硝酸盐径流、充当温室气体（GHG）排放的汇，并且与玉米乙醇相比，在提供同等体积生物燃料时占用的粮食作物用地更少，但成本显著更高。本文量化了伊利诺伊州桑格蒙流域中不同类型生物燃料在利润、粮食与燃料生产、温室气体排放及硝酸盐径流削减之间的权衡，分析了生物燃料的最优组合，以及应辅以强制配比的政策，以实现多重环境结果。我们发现，相较于仅由玉米乙醇满足强制配比的情形，在强制配比水平中纤维素生物燃料占三分之二，可使硝酸盐径流减少20%，同时温室气体排放减少88–100%，但根据采用温室气体政策还是硝酸盐政策，利润将减少15–27%。此外，在实现相同硝酸盐削减水平的情况下，温室气体政策下用于生产纤维素生物燃料的玉米秸秆与芒草之比，高于硝酸盐政策下的比例。我们的结果表明，生物燃料的最优组合以及促使其实现的政策，取决于环境目标，以及社会愿意在低成本能源安全、粮食生产和各种环境效益之间做出的权衡。

title: Optimal Mix of Vertical Integration and Contracting for Energy Crops: Effect of Risk Preferences and Land Quality
abstract: Long‐term contracts are likely to be critical to induce the production of perennial energy crops as a feedstock for the emerging cellulosic biofuel industry. This paper develops a framework to analyze the determinants of landowner choice among a land‐leasing contract, a fixed‐price contract, and a revenue‐sharing contract for energy crop production. We examine the effect of heterogeneous landowners' risk and time preferences and land quality on the optimal mix and equilibrium terms of these contracts, which jointly maximize the net benefits of the refinery and landowners in a region; this has implications for the extent to which energy crop production is likely to be vertically integrated or independently contracted by a biorefinery. We find that the refinery can potentially earn a higher profit by offering a choice of these three types of contracts rather than a single type of contract only; by allowing self‐selection of contract type based on landowner risk and time preferences, the contractual terms needed to induce production of energy crops are reduced. Although it is optimal for vertically‐integrated and contracted production to co‐exist, we find that the share of the former is predominant across a range of assumptions about the distribution of risk preferences, time preferences, and relative riskiness of conventional and energy crop production. We also find that the impact of having multiple contract types to choose from on landowners' welfare is ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 长期合约对于促使多年生能源作物成为新兴纤维素生物燃料产业的原料，可能至关重要。本文构建了一个框架，用以分析土地所有者在土地租赁合约、固定价格合约和收益分成合约之间选择的决定因素，以用于能源作物生产。我们考察了异质性土地所有者的风险与时间偏好以及土地质量对这三类合约的最优组合和均衡条款的影响，这些条款共同使一个地区内炼油厂和土地所有者的净收益最大化；这关系到能源作物生产在多大程度上可能由生物炼厂纵向一体化经营，或由其独立签约生产。我们发现，相比只提供单一类型的合约，炼油厂通过提供三种合约类型的选择，可能获得更高的利润；由于允许土地所有者基于其风险与时间偏好进行自我选择，诱导能源作物生产所需的合约条款得以降低。尽管纵向一体化生产与签约生产并存是最优的，但在关于风险偏好分布、时间偏好以及常规作物与能源作物生产相对风险性的一系列假设下，前者的份额都占主导地位。我们还发现，多种合约类型可供选择对土地所有者福利的影响并不明确。

title: Abatement Cost of GHG Emissions for Wood-based Electricity and Ethanol at Production and Consumption Levels
abstract: Woody feedstocks will play a critical role in meeting the demand for biomass-based energy products in the US. We developed an integrated model using comparable system boundaries and common set of assumptions to ascertain unit cost and greenhouse gas (GHG) intensity of electricity and ethanol derived from slash pine (Pinus elliottii) at the production and consumption levels by considering existing automobile technologies. We also calculated abatement cost of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions with respect to comparable energy products derived from fossil fuels. The production cost of electricity derived using wood chips was at least cheaper by 1 ¢ MJ-1 over electricity derived from wood pellets. The production cost of ethanol without any income from cogenerated electricity was costlier by about 0.7 ¢ MJ-1 than ethanol with income from cogenerated electricity. The production cost of electricity derived from wood chips was cheaper by at least 0.7 ¢ MJ-1 than the energy equivalent cost of ethanol produced in presence of cogenerated electricity. The cost of using ethanol as a fuel in a flex-fuel vehicle was at least higher by 6 ¢ km-1 than a comparable electric vehicle. The GHG intensity of per km distance traveled in a flex-fuel vehicle was greater or lower than an electric vehicle running on electricity derived from wood chips depending on presence and absence of GHG credits related with co-generated electricity. A carbon tax of at least $7 Mg CO2e-1 and $30 Mg CO2e-1 is needed to promote wood-based electricity and ethanol production in the US, respectively. The range of abatement cost of GHG emissions is significantly dependent on the harvest age and selected baseline especially for electricity generation.
abstract_zh: 木质原料将在满足美国生物质能源产品需求中发挥关键作用。我们构建了一个综合模型，采用可比的系统边界和统一的假设条件，测算了由湿地松（Pinus elliottii）在生产和消费层面生产的电力和乙醇的单位成本与温室气体（GHG）强度，并考虑了现有汽车技术。我们还计算了温室气体减排的成本，以与来自化石燃料的可比能源产品进行比较。使用木片生产的电力，其生产成本比使用木质颗粒生产的电力至少低1美分/MJ。在没有热电联产电力收入的情况下，乙醇的生产成本比有热电联产收入时高出约0.7美分/MJ。使用木片生产的电力，其成本比在有热电联产电力情况下生产的等能量乙醇成本至少低0.7美分/MJ。在柔性燃料汽车中使用乙醇作为燃料的成本，比同类电动汽车至少高6美分/公里。柔性燃料汽车每行驶一公里的温室气体强度，相对于使用木片发电的电动汽车，取决于是否存在与热电联产电力相关的温室气体抵免，可能更高也可能更低。若要促进基于木材的电力和乙醇生产，美国分别需要至少每Mg CO2e−1 7美元和30美元的碳税。温室气体减排成本的范围在很大程度上取决于采伐年龄和所选基准，尤其是对于发电而言。

title: Alternative Fuel Standards: Welfare Effects and Climate Benefits
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper develops a conceptual framework and a numerical simulation model of the fuel and agricultural sectors in the US to analyze the effects of the existing Renewable Fuels Standard (RFS) that mandates the blending of specific volumes of low carbon biofuels with liquid fossil fuels and a proposed national Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) that imposes a limit on the GHG intensity of the blended fuel on fuel mix, GHG emissions and social welfare in an open economy and to compare them to those with a carbon price policy. The conceptual framework illustrates that, unlike a carbon price policy, the RFS and LCFS have an ambiguous effect on GHG emissions. The numerical analysis shows that all three policies reduce US GHG emissions and increase domestic social welfare relative to a no-policy, business-as usual scenario, with the RFS leading to a lower reduction in GHG emissions than the LCFS. However, the RFS leads to higher social welfare among the policies examined here than the LCFS and the carbon tax.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了美国燃料与农业部门的概念框架和数值模拟模型，用以分析现行《可再生燃料标准》（RFS，要求在液体化石燃料中掺入特定体积的低碳生物燃料）以及拟议的全国低碳燃料标准（LCFS，对混合燃料的温室气体强度设定上限，从而影响燃料组合）对开放经济中燃料组合、温室气体排放和社会福利的影响，并将其与碳价格政策进行比较。概念框架表明，与碳价格政策不同，RFS和LCFS对温室气体排放的影响并不明确。数值分析表明，相对于无政策的“照常营业”情景，三种政策均能减少美国温室气体排放并提高国内社会福利，其中RFS带来的温室气体减排幅度低于LCFS。然而，在本文考察的政策中，RFS带来的社会福利高于LCFS和碳税。

title: Does Pollution Prevention Reduce Toxic Releases? A Dynamic Panel Model
abstract: This paper investigates the effectiveness of voluntary pollution prevention activities in reducing toxic releases of facilities that report to the Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) from 1991-2001 using GMM dynamic panel data models that recognize the potential endogeneity of the pollution prevention adoption decision on toxic releases. We find that pollution prevention adoption had a negative impact on toxic releases over this period. The estimated coefficients suggest that the effect of the introduction of pollution prevention techniques is substantial, but short-lived, dissipating within 4-5 years. However, a continual adoption of pollution prevention techniques leads to lower steady-state toxic emissions, with estimated reductions in the 35-50% range (depending on specification).
abstract_zh: 本文利用GMM动态面板数据模型，考察了1991–2001年间向有毒物排放清单（TRI）报告的设施中，自愿性污染预防活动在减少有毒物排放方面的有效性。该模型考虑了污染预防采纳决策对有毒物排放可能存在的内生性。我们发现，在此期间，采纳污染预防措施对有毒物排放产生了负面影响。估计系数表明，引入污染预防技术的效果显著，但持续时间较短，在4–5年内即消散。然而，持续采纳污染预防技术可使稳态有毒物排放水平降低，估计降幅在35–50%区间内（取决于具体设定）。

title: Estimates of Biomass Yield for Perennial Bioenergy Grasses in the United States
Globalization and Voluntary Environmental Management in Developing Countries
Green Management and the Nature of Pollution Prevention
abstract: Management systems have a strong impact on the level of innovation and on production operations. Understanding this impact sheds light on how firms function. This paper examines the relationship between a firm’s approach to environmental management and the nature of the pollution prevention activities or practices that it undertakes. We differentiate pollution prevention activities according to (i) four functional characteristics and (ii) visibility to consumers. We find that the application of the Total Quality Management approaches on pollution prevention has a stronger effect for practices that involve procedural changes or are of a customized nature. These are indeed the type of practices where one would expect Total Quality Management to have a disproportionate impact in decision-making effectiveness. There seems to be no corresponding effect on the adoption of practices that are visible to consumers. Our results corroborate the notion that a well-designed management system can help stimulate innovation, but only for specific types. They also help identify the types of firms that are more likely to benefit from adoption of Total Quality Management principles.
abstract_zh: 管理体系对创新水平和生产运营具有重大影响。理解这种影响有助于揭示企业如何运作。本文考察了企业的环境管理方式与其所开展的污染预防活动或措施性质之间的关系。我们依据（i）四个功能特征和（ii）对消费者的可见性，对污染预防活动进行了区分。我们发现，全面质量管理（TQM）方法在污染预防上的应用，对涉及程序性变革或具有定制化性质的措施效果更为显著。这些正是人们预期全面质量管理会对决策效率产生不成比例影响的措施类型。对于消费者可见的措施，则未见相应的影响。我们的结果支持这样一种观点：设计良好的管理体系可以帮助激发创新，但仅限于特定类型。研究结果也有助于识别哪些类型的企业更有可能从采纳全面质量管理原则中获益。

title: Greenhouse Gas Benefits of Transatlantic Wood Pellet Trade
abstract: Power utility companies in the United Kingdom are using imported wood pellets from the southern region of the United States for electricity generation to meet the legally binding mandate of sourcing 15% of the nation's total energy consumption from renewable sources by 2020. This study ascertains relative savings in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions for a unit of electricity generated using imported wood pellet in the United Kingdom under 930 different scenarios: three woody feedstocks (logging residues, pulpwood, and logging residues and pulpwood combined), two forest management choices (intensive and non-intensive), 31 plantation rotation ages (year 10 to year 40 in steps of 1 year), and five power plant capacities (20–100 MW in steps of 20 MW). Relative savings in GHG emissions with respect to a unit of electricity derived from fossil fuels in the United Kingdom range between 50% and 68% depending upon the capacity of power plant and rotation age. Relative savings in GHG emissions increase with higher power plant capacity. GHG emissions related to wood pellet production and transatlantic shipment of wood pellets typically contribute about 48% and 31% of total GHG emissions, respectively. Overall, use of imported wood pellets for electricity generation could help in reducing the United Kingdom's GHG emissions. We suggest that future research be directed to evaluation of the impacts of additional forest management practices, changing climate, and soil carbon on the overall savings in GHG emissions related to transatlantic wood pellet trade.
abstract_zh: 英国的电力公司正使用从美国南部进口的木质颗粒发电，以满足到2020年将全国能源消费的15%来自可再生能源这一具有法律约束力的要求。本研究在930种不同情景下，确定了使用进口木质颗粒在英国发电时，每单位电力相对的温室气体（GHG）减排量。这些情景包括：三种木质原料（采伐剩余物、纸浆材，以及采伐剩余物与纸浆材的组合）、两种森林经营方式（集约型和非集约型）、31个人工林轮伐期（第10至第40年，每年递增1年），以及五种发电厂装机容量（20–100兆瓦，每级递增20兆瓦）。相对于英国化石燃料发电的单位电力，温室气体减排幅度在50%至68%之间，取决于电厂装机容量和轮伐期。温室气体减排幅度随电厂装机容量的提高而增加。木质颗粒生产及跨大西洋运输所产生的温室气体，通常分别约占温室气体排放总量的48%和31%。总体而言，使用进口木质颗粒发电有助于减少英国的温室气体排放。我们建议未来研究应评估额外的森林经营措施、气候变化以及土壤碳对跨大西洋木质颗粒贸易整体温室气体减排效果的影响。

title: Is Use of Both Pulpwood and Logging Residues Instead of Only Logging Residues for Bioenergy Development a Viable Carbon Mitigation Strategy?
Modeling Land Use Change with Biofuels
venue: Book chapter: Oxford Handbook of Land Economics
abstract: The introduction of biofuels to agriculture has led to a new reality by linking agricultural and livestock sectors with energy markets. This article reviews the underlying assumptions and major findings of models being used to measure the land use impact of biofuels to develop an understanding of the drivers of land use change with biofuels. These studies show that biofuels have the potential to meet a significant percentage of liquid fuel demand and demand for renewable electricity in the future and that current targets being set in the United States and the European Union for renewable fuels are feasible with moderate increases in crop prices. Models differ in their assessment of the magnitude and location of global land use change due to biofuels but show that some trade-offs between food and fuel production are inevitable. High yielding feedstocks and growth in productivity of food crops can mitigate the adverse impacts of biofuels.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料进入农业领域，使农业和畜牧业部门与能源市场联系在一起，形成了新的局面。本文回顾了用于衡量生物燃料土地利用影响的模型的基本假设和主要发现，以理解生物燃料引发土地利用变化的驱动因素。这些研究表明，生物燃料未来有潜力满足相当大比例的液体燃料需求和可再生电力需求；美国和欧盟目前为可再生燃料设定的目标，在作物价格适度上涨的情况下是可行的。不同模型对全球生物燃料引起的土地利用变化的规模和地理位置的评估存在差异，但都表明，粮食与燃料生产之间不可避免地存在某些权衡。高产原料以及粮食作物生产率的增长，可以减轻生物燃料的不利影响。

title: Wood-based Bioenergy Products - Land or Energy Efficient?
abstract: Woody feedstocks will play an important role in meeting the total demand for biomass to generate electricity and produce ethanol in the United States. We analyzed 186 different scenarios (31 rotation ages (10 to 40 years in annual time steps); two types of forest management (intensive and nonintensive); and three feedstocks (logging residues only, pulpwood only, logging residues and pulpwood combined)) for ascertaining relative savings in greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions of two wood-based energy products (electricity and ethanol) on per unit land and per unit energy bases with respect to equivalent fossil fuel based energy products. Relative savings in GHG emissions were higher under intensive forest management compared with nonintensive forest management on a per unit land basis, whereas this situation reverses on a per unit energy basis. Combined use of pulpwood and logging residues saved the highest amount of GHG emissions on a per unit land basis, but on a per unit energy basis, relative GHG savings were similar to when only logging residues were used as a feedstock. Existing policies promoting bioenergy development in the United States only consider GHG savings on a per unit energy basis. A need exists to consider GHG savings on a per unit land basis as well to ensure efficient utilization of existing land resources to mitigate GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: 木质原料将在满足美国发电和生产乙醇的生物质总需求中发挥重要作用。我们分析了186种不同情景（31种轮伐期（10至40年，按年递增）；两种森林经营方式（集约型和非集约型）；以及三种原料（仅采伐剩余物、仅纸浆材，以及采伐剩余物与纸浆材的组合）），以确定两种基于木质的生物能源产品（电力和乙醇）相对于同等化石燃料能源产品的温室气体（GHG）减排幅度，分别以单位土地和单位能量为基础进行比较。以单位土地计，集约型森林经营的温室气体减排幅度高于非集约型，但以单位能量计，情况则相反。以单位土地计，纸浆材与采伐剩余物组合使用所节约的温室气体最多，但以单位能量计，相对减排量与仅使用采伐剩余物时相近。美国现行促进生物能源发展的政策仅以单位能量计算温室气体减排量。有必要同时以单位土地计算温室气体减排量，以确保高效利用现有土地资源来减缓温室气体排放。

title: Assessing Participation in Voluntary Environmental Programmes in the Developing World: The Role of FDI and Export Orientation on ISO14001 Adoption in Thailand, 2013
abstract: Empirical assessments of the determinants of firm participation in Voluntary Environmental Programmes (VEPs) in the developing world are largely absent from the environmental regulation literature, leaving a number of important factors unique to such countries unexplored. This article examines these factors, namely the roles played by Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and export orientation, in addition to factors deemed important in the industrialized world context to the problem of ISO14001 adoption in one developing nation, Thailand. We make use of unique primary data from 494 firms, and focus on three important industries, the resource-based food and beverages industry, the labour-intensive textiles and wearing apparel industry, and the more high-technology electronics and electrical appliances industry. We find that FDI plays a role in ISO14001 adoption, especially FDI from Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) and ISO14001-rich countries. Other important determinants include firm size, experience with ISO9000, and production of intermediate products. Firms faced with fewer obstacles to environmental improvements such as those facing lower costs, having more understanding of the procedure, and with greater access to the appropriate technology are also more likely to adopt ISO14001.
abstract_zh: 关于发展中国家企业参与自愿环境计划（VEP）的决定因素，环境规制文献中基本缺乏实证评估，使得这类国家特有的一些重要因素尚未得到探讨。本文考察了这些因素，即外商直接投资（FDI）和出口导向所发挥的作用，以及在工业化国家情境中被视为重要的、用于解释ISO14001采纳问题的其他因素，并以泰国这一发展中国家为例。我们使用了来自494家企业的独特一手数据，并重点关注三个重要行业：以资源为基础的食品饮料行业、劳动密集型的纺织和服装行业，以及技术含量较高的电子电器行业。我们发现，外商直接投资在ISO14001采纳中发挥作用，尤其是来自经济合作与发展组织（OECD）国家及ISO14001普及程度较高国家的外商直接投资。其他重要决定因素包括企业规模、ISO9000经验以及中间产品的生产。面临较少环境改善障碍的企业，例如成本较低、对程序更为了解、更容易获得适当技术的企业，也更有可能采纳ISO14001。

title: Can India Meet Biofuel Policy Targets? Implications for Food and Fuel Prices
Economic, Energy Security and Greenhouse Gas Effects of Biofuels: Implications for Policy
Food vs. Fuel: The Effect of Biofuel Policies
abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) and the existing accompanying volumetric ethanol excise tax credit (VEETC) and import tariff on food prices in the US relative to a counter-factual business-as-usual (BAU) scenario. It shows that policies like the VEETC and import tariff that accompany the RFS can delay the transition to advanced bio-fuels and exacerbate the negative impact of the RFS on food crop prices. The extent to which this will be the case will depend on technological developments in the next decade. If the costs of sugarcane ethanol and cellulosic ethanol are relatively high making them less competitive with corn ethanol, then these tax credits and tariff will have much smaller impacts on the mix of bio-fuels and on food prices than otherwise; advanced bio-fuels would then at best be able to meet the minimum mandated levels.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了《可再生燃料标准》（RFS）及其配套的乙醇体积消费税抵免（VEETC）和进口关税对美国食品价格的影响，并与“照常营业”（BAU）的反事实情景进行比较。研究表明，VEETC和进口关税等与RFS配套的政策，可能会延缓向先进生物燃料的转型，并加剧RFS对粮食作物价格的负面影响。其影响程度将取决于未来十年的技术发展。如果甘蔗乙醇和纤维素乙醇的成本相对较高，使其与玉米乙醇的竞争力较弱，那么这些税收抵免和关税对生物燃料组合及食品价格的影响，将比其他情况小得多；在这种情况下，先进生物燃料至多只能满足最低强制配比水平。

title: Land Use and Economic Effects of Alternative Biofuel Policies in Brazil and the U.S
Motivations for Proactive Environmental Management
abstract: This paper examines the extent to which there are differential incentives that motivate the adoption of environmental management practices (EMPs) and pollution prevention (P2) methods. We analyze the role of internal drivers such as managerial attitudes towards the environment and external pressures using both observed characteristics of facilities and perceived pressures. We estimate a structural equation model using survey data from facilities in Oregon that involves simultaneous estimation of the latent dependent and explanatory variables and the two regression equations explaining adoption behavior of EMPs and P2. We find that perceived regulatory pressures and managerial attitudes have a statistically significant impact on the adoption of both EMPs and P2 practices, while market pressures were significant in influencing the adoption of EMPs but not P2 methods. Furthermore; we find that both external regulatory pressures and internal managerial attitudes had a larger impact in motivating adoption by facilities that did not view environmental issues as being a significant concern as compared to facilities that did.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了哪些差异化激励因素会推动环境管理实践（EMP）和污染预防（P2）方法的采纳。我们利用设施的可观测特征和感知压力，分析了内部驱动因素（如管理者对环境的态度）以及外部压力的作用。我们使用俄勒冈州设施的调查数据，估计了一个结构方程模型，该模型同时估计潜在的因变量和解释变量，以及解释EMP和P2采纳行为的两个回归方程。我们发现，感知到的监管压力和管理者态度对EMP和P2实践的采纳均有统计上显著的影响，而市场压力对EMP的采纳有显著影响，对P2方法则没有。此外，我们发现，对于那些不认为环境问题是重要关切的设施，外部监管压力和内部管理者态度对其采纳行为的激励作用，都比对那些认为环境问题重要的设施更大。

title: Oligopolies with (Somewhat) Environmentally Conscious Consumers: Market Equilibrium and Regulatory Intervention
venue: Journal of Economics and Management Strategy
abstract: We consider a horizontally differentiated duopoly where consumers care about the product's “greenness.” Firms can be asymmetric: they may differ in the product's intrinsic value and may also differ in their chosen level of greenness. We examine the choice of greenness and the implications of various policy interventions. We show that (i) the choices of product greenness are strategic substitutes, (ii) the high‐intrinsic quality firm produces the greener product, (iii) the low‐quality firm's greenness may increase with the cost of its provision or decrease with consumer willingness to pay for it, (iv) a minimum quality standard (MQS) leads the greener firm to lower its environmental quality and can even reduce average quality, (v) greenness is underprovided even if consumers fully internalize the externality, and (v) an MQS can reduce welfare if the greenness of the high‐quality firm exceeds the MQS, even when environmental quality is underprovided. The effects of policy interventions on profits differ qualitatively across polices and firms: A firm that lobbies for one type of intervention may lobby against another similar one, and a firm may lobby for an intervention while its competitor may lobby against it. A subsidy for the development costs of a green product can financially hurt both firms.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个水平差异化的双寡头市场，其中消费者关心产品的“绿色程度”。企业可能是不对称的：它们可能在产品的内在价值上存在差异，也可能在所选择的绿色程度上存在差异。我们考察了绿色程度的选择以及各种政策干预的影响。我们证明：（i）产品绿色程度的选择呈战略替代关系；（ii）内在质量较高的企业生产较绿色的产品；（iii）低质量企业的绿色程度，可能随其提供成本的上升而提高，或随消费者对其支付意愿的上升而降低；（iv）最低质量标准（MQS）会使较绿色的企业降低其环境质量，甚至可能降低平均质量；（v）即使消费者完全内部化外部性，绿色程度仍然供给不足；（v）若高质量企业的绿色程度超过MQS，即使环境质量供给不足，MQS也可能降低福利。政策干预对利润的影响在不同政策和不同企业之间存在质的差异：一家企业可能游说支持某一类干预，却反对另一类相似的干预；一家企业可能游说支持某项干预，而其竞争对手则可能游说反对该项干预。对绿色产品开发成本的补贴，在财务上可能同时损害两家企业。

title: Stacking Low Carbon Policies on the Renewable Fuel Standard: Economic and Greenhouse Gas Implications
abstract: This paper examines the economic and GHG implications of stacking a low carbon fuel standard (LCFS) with and without a carbon price policy on the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS). We compare the performance of various policy combinations for food and fuel prices, fuel mix and fuel consumption. We also analyze the economic costs and benefits of alternative policy combinations and their distributional effects for consumers and producers in the transportation and agricultural sector in the US. Using a dynamic, multi-market equilibrium, nonlinear mathematical programming model of the transportation and agricultural sectors, we find that combining the RFS with an LCFS policy leads to a reduction in first generation biofuels and an increase in second generation biofuels compared to the RFS alone. This policy combination also achieves greater reduction in GHG emissions even after considering offsetting market mediated effects. Imposition of a carbon price with the RFS and LCFS policy primarily induces fuel conservation and achieves larger GHG emissions reduction compared to the other policy scenarios. All of these policy combination lead to higher net economic benefits for the transportation and agricultural sectors relative to the no policy baseline because they improve the terms of trade for these sectors.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在《可再生燃料标准》（RFS）之上叠加低碳燃料标准（LCFS）（有或无碳价格政策）的经济和温室气体影响。我们比较了各种政策组合对食品和燃料价格、燃料组合及燃料消费的影响。我们还分析了各替代政策组合的经济成本与收益，以及其对美国交通运输和农业部门的消费者与生产者的分配效应。利用一个针对交通运输和农业部门的动态、多市场均衡非线性数学规划模型，我们发现，相较于仅实施RFS，将RFS与LCFS相结合会减少第一代生物燃料，并增加第二代生物燃料。即使在考虑了市场中介的抵消效应之后，这一政策组合仍能实现更大的温室气体减排。在RFS与LCFS政策基础上叠加碳价格，主要诱导燃料节约，与其他政策情景相比，实现了更大的温室气体减排。所有这些政策组合相对于无政策基准都带来了更高的净经济收益，因为它们改善了交通运输和农业部门的贸易条件。

title: Voluntary Approaches for Environmental Protection
Determinants of Participation vs. Consumption in the Swan Eco-Labeled Paper Products Market
Economic and Institutional Factors Affecting Business Environmental Management
Explaining the Reductions in Corn Ethanol Processing Costs: Testing Competing Hypothesis
Land Use and Greenhouse Gas Implications of Biofuels: Role of Technology and Policy
abstract: This paper examines the changes in land use in the U.S. likely to be induced by biofuel and climate policies and the implications of these policies for greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions over the 2007–2022 period. The policies considered here include a modified Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) by itself as well as combined with a cellulosic biofuel tax credit or a carbon price policy. We use a dynamic, spatial, multi-market equilibrium model, Biofuel and Environmental Policy Analysis Model (BEPAM), to endogenously determine the effects of these policies on cropland allocation, food and fuel prices, and the mix of first- and second-generation biofuels. We find that the RFS could be met by diverting 6% of cropland for biofuel production and would result in corn prices increasing by 16% in 2002 relative to the business-as-usual baseline. The reduction in GHG emissions in the U.S. due to the RFS is about 2%; these domestic GHG savings can be severely eroded by emissions due to indirect land-use changes and the increase in gasoline consumption in the rest of the world. Supplementing the RFS with a carbon price policy or a cellulosic biofuel tax credit induces a switch away from corn ethanol to cellulosic biofuels and achieves the mandated level of biofuel production with a smaller adverse impact on crop prices. These supplementary policies enhance the GHG savings achieved by the RFS alone, although through different mechanisms; greater production of cellulosic biofuels with the tax credit but larger reduction in fossil fuel consumption with a carbon tax.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了生物燃料和气候政策可能引致的美国土地利用变化，以及这些政策在2007–2022年期间对温室气体（GHG）排放的影响。所考虑的政策包括：经修订的《可再生燃料标准》（RFS）单独实施，以及RFS与纤维素生物燃料税收抵免或碳价格政策相结合。我们使用动态、空间、多市场均衡模型——生物燃料与环境政策分析模型（BEPAM），内生地确定这些政策对耕地配置、食品和燃料价格，以及第一代与第二代生物燃料组合的影响。我们发现，RFS可通过将6%的耕地用于生物燃料生产来满足，并使2002年的玉米价格相对于照常营业基准上涨16%。RFS使美国温室气体排放减少约2%；但这些国内温室气体减排量可能因间接土地利用变化以及世界其他地区汽油消费的增加而大幅削弱。在RFS之外补充碳价格政策或纤维素生物燃料税收抵免，会促使玉米乙醇转向纤维素生物燃料，并以较小的作物价格负面影响实现规定的生物燃料产量目标。这些补充政策以不同机制增强了单独RFS的温室气体减排效果：税收抵免带来纤维素生物燃料产量的增加，而碳税则带来化石燃料消费的更大削减。

title: Measuring Indirect Land Use Change with Biofuels: Implications for Policy
abstract: The indirect land use change (ILUC) effect of biofuels has called into question the greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation benefit of biofuels compared with that of fossil fuels. This article reviews the various economic modeling approaches being used to assess the ILUC effect and discusses the key factors that influence estimates of its magnitude. We find that there is considerable variability in the magnitude of ILUC associated with a biofuel pathway across studies and within a study, depending on underlying model parameters. These estimates are sensitive to the scale of biofuel production, the mix of policies and biofuels considered, variations in the parametric assumptions that govern price transmission through international trade, and the ease of changes in land use at the intensive and extensive margins. We discuss the challenges in implementing policies to address ILUC.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料的间接土地利用变化（ILUC）效应使人们质疑，与化石燃料相比，生物燃料的温室气体减排效益。本文回顾了用于评估ILUC效应的各种经济建模方法，并讨论了影响其规模估计的关键因素。我们发现，同一生物燃料路径的ILUC规模在不同研究之间，甚至在同一研究内部，都存在相当大的差异，这取决于基础模型参数。这些估计对生物燃料生产规模、所考虑的政策与生物燃料组合、国际贸易中价格传导的参数假设，以及集约和外延边际上土地利用变化的难易程度都很敏感。我们讨论了实施ILUC应对政策所面临的挑战。

title: Meeting the Mandate for Biofuels: Implications for Land Use, Food and Fuel Prices
venue: Book chapter: The Intended & Unintended Effects of U.S. Agricultural & Biotechnology Policies
abstract: Biofuel production is being promoted through various policies such as mandates and tax credits. This paper uses a dynamic, spatial, multi-market equilibrium model, Biofuel and Environmental Policy Analysis Model (BEPAM), to estimate the effects of these policies on cropland allocation, food and fuel prices, and the mix of biofuels from corn and cellulosic feedstocks over the 2007-2022 period. We find that the biofuel mandate will increase corn price by 24%, reduce the price of gasoline by 8% in 2022, and increase social welfare by $122 B (0.7%) relative to Business As Usual scenario. The provision of volumetric tax credits that accompany the mandate significantly changes the mix of biofuels produced in favor of cellulosic biofuels and reduces the share of corn ethanol in the cumulative volume of biofuels produced from 50% to 10%.The tax credits reduce the adverse impact of the mandate alone on crop prices and decrease the price of biofuels. However, they impose a welfare cost of $79 B compared to the mandate alone. These results are found to be sensitive to the rate of growth of crop productivity, the costs of production of bioenergy crops, and the availability of marginal land for producing bioenergy crops.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料生产正通过强制配比和税收抵免等多种政策得到推动。本文采用动态、空间、多市场均衡模型——生物燃料与环境政策分析模型（BEPAM），估计了这些政策在2007–2022年期间对耕地配置、食品和燃料价格，以及由玉米和纤维素原料构成的生物燃料组合的影响。我们发现，生物燃料强制配比将使玉米价格上涨24%，使2022年汽油价格下降8%，并相对于照常营业情景使社会福利增加1,220亿美元（0.7%）。伴随强制配比的体积税收抵免显著改变了生物燃料的生产结构，使纤维素生物燃料的比重上升，并使玉米乙醇在累计生物燃料产量中的份额从50%降至10%。税收抵免减轻了单独强制配比对作物价格的不利影响，并降低了生物燃料价格。然而，与单独实施强制配比相比，税收抵免带来790亿美元的福利成本。这些结果对作物生产率的增长速度、能源作物的生产成本以及可用于种植能源作物的边际土地的可得性较为敏感。

title: Modeling the Land-use and Greenhouse-gas Implications of Biofuels
abstract: The emergence of biofuels as an agricultural commodity has integrated the agricultural, energy and livestock sectors and expanded the scope of models being used to analyze the effects of energy policies. It has increased the importance of incorporating spatial heterogeneity in land availability and productivity and information about the biophysical and economic determinants of land use change at multiple spatial scales. Since biofuels affect food and fuel prices, they have expanded the boundaries of economic models to consider not only their direct but also their indirect effects on land use and greenhouse gas emissions. This paper describes the demand-side and supply-side determinants of these direct and indirect changes in land use and greenhouse gas emissions with biofuels. We discuss the major modeling approaches used to analyze these effects, their strengths, limitations and key findings and directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料成为一种农产品，使农业、能源和畜牧业部门整合在一起，并扩大了用于分析能源政策效应的模型范围。这使得在多个空间尺度上纳入土地可得性与生产率的空间异质性，以及土地利用变化的生物物理和经济决定因素，变得更加重要。由于生物燃料影响食品和燃料价格，它们将经济模型的边界扩展到不仅考虑其直接影响，也考虑其对土地利用和温室气体排放的间接影响。本文阐述了生物燃料引起这些直接和间接土地利用及温室气体排放变化的需求侧和供给侧决定因素。我们讨论了用于分析这些影响的主要建模方法，它们的优势、局限性和主要发现，以及未来研究的方向。

title: Stimulating Learning-By-Doing in Advanced Biofuels: Effectiveness of Alternative Policies
The Market-Mediated Effects of Low Carbon Fuel Policies
Agave for Tequila and Biofuels: An Economic Assessment and Potential Opportunities
Can Biofuels be a Solution to Climate Change? The Implications of Land Use Change Related Emissions for Policy
abstract: Biofuels have gained increasing attention as an alternative to fossil fuels for several reasons, one of which is their potential to reduce the greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from the transportation sector. Recent studies have questioned the validity of claims about the potential of biofuels to reduce GHG emissions relative to the liquid fossil fuels they are replacing when emissions owing to direct (DLUC) and indirect land use changes (ILUC) that accompany biofuels are included in the life cycle GHG intensity of biofuels. Studies estimate that the GHG emissions released from ILUC could more than offset the direct GHG savings by producing biofuels and replacing liquid fossil fuels and create a ‘carbon debt’ with a long payback period. The estimates of this payback period, however, vary widely across biofuels from different feedstocks and even for a single biofuel across different modelling assumptions. In the case of corn ethanol, this payback period is found to range from 15 to 200 years. We discuss the challenges in estimating the ILUC effect of a biofuel and differences across biofuels, and its sensitivity to the assumptions and policy scenarios considered by different economic models. We also discuss the implications of ILUC for designing policies that promote biofuels and seek to reduce GHG emissions. In a first-best setting, a global carbon tax is needed to set both DLUC and ILUC emissions to their optimal levels. However, it is unclear whether unilateral GHG mitigation policies, even if they penalize the ILUC-related emissions, would increase social welfare and lead to optimal emission levels. In the absence of a global carbon tax, incentivizing sustainable land use practices through certification standards, government regulations and market-based pressures may be a viable option for reducing ILUC.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料作为化石燃料的替代品，因有望减少交通运输部门的温室气体（GHG）排放而受到越来越多的关注。近期研究对生物燃料相对于其所替代的液体化石燃料能否减少温室气体排放的说法提出了质疑，尤其是在将生物燃料所伴随的直接土地利用变化（DLUC）和间接土地利用变化（ILUC）排放纳入其全生命周期温室气体强度的情况下。研究估计，ILUC产生的温室气体排放可能超过生产生物燃料并替代液体化石燃料所带来的直接减排，从而形成回收期很长的“碳债务”。然而，这一回收期的估计在不同原料的生物燃料之间差异很大，即使是同一种生物燃料，在不同的建模假设下也存在差异。就玉米乙醇而言，该回收期的估计范围为15至200年。我们讨论了估计生物燃料ILUC效应的挑战、不同生物燃料之间的差异，以及不同经济模型对假设和政策情景的敏感性。我们还讨论了ILUC对于设计促进生物燃料并旨在减少温室气体排放的政策的启示。在第一最优情形下，需要全球碳税来将DLUC和ILUC排放都设定在最优水平。然而，即使单边温室气体减排政策对与ILUC相关的排放进行了惩罚，是否会增加社会福利并达到最优排放水平，也并不明确。在缺乏全球碳税的情况下，通过认证标准、政府监管和市场压力来激励可持续土地利用实践，可能是减少ILUC的一种可行选择。

title: Fostering Regulatory Compliance: the Role of Environmental Self-Auditing and Audit Policies
abstract: This paper examines the effect of voluntary efforts to self-audit on compliance with Clean Air Act regulations. It also examines the effect that state audit privilege and immunity laws have on the incentives for auditing and for improving compliance. Using data for a sample of S&P 500 firms, we correct for the endogeneity of the environmental audit decision by estimating a bivariate probit model with 'compliance status’ and 'decision to self-audit’ as two discrete choice variables. Our empirical analysis controls for compliance and self-auditing incentives created by regulatory and community-based pressures. We find that those facilities belonging to firms that have been subject to inspections in the past, that face a stronger threat of liabilities for Superfund sites, and that are more visible due to size are more likely to undertake an environmental audit. State audit privilege and immunity laws are not found to have a statistically significant effect on incentives for self-auditing. Facilities that self-audit are more likely to be in compliance with Clean Air Act regulations. However, audit privilege policies are found to have a statistically significant negative impact on compliance while audit immunity laws are found to have an insignificant impact on compliance.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了自愿性自我审计对遵守《清洁空气法》法规的影响，并考察了州级审计特权与豁免法律对审计激励以及改善合规状况的影响。利用标普500指数企业的数据，我们通过估计二元概率（bivariate probit）模型来校正环境审计决策的内生性，该模型以“合规状态”和“自我审计决策”作为两个离散选择变量。我们的实证分析控制了监管和社区压力所产生的合规与自我审计激励。我们发现，过去曾接受检查、面临超级基金场地更大责任威胁，以及因规模而更为显眼的设施，更有可能开展环境审计。州级审计特权与豁免法律对自我审计激励未发现统计上显著的影响。开展自我审计的设施更有可能符合《清洁空气法》的规定。然而，审计特权政策被发现对合规有统计上显著的负面影响，而审计豁免法律对合规的影响并不显著。

abstract: This study integrates a biophysical model with a county‐specific economic analysis of breakeven prices of bioenergy crop production to assess the biophysical and economic potential of biofuel production in the Midwestern United States. The bioenergy crops considered in this study include a genotype of Miscanthus, Miscanthus×giganteus, and the Cave‐in‐Rock breed of switchgrass (Panicum virgatum). The estimated average peak biomass yield for miscanthus in the Midwestern states ranges between 7 and 48 metric tons dry matter per hectare per year ( t DM ha−1 yr−1), while that for switchgrass is between 10 and 16 t DM ha−1 yr−1. With the exception of Minnesota and Wisconsin, where miscanthus yields are likely to be low due to cold soil temperatures, the yield of miscanthus is on average more than two times higher than yield of switchgrass. We find that the breakeven price, which includes the cost of producing the crop and the opportunity cost of land, of producing miscanthus ranges from $53 t−1 DM in Missouri to $153 t−1 DM in Minnesota in the low‐cost scenario. Corresponding costs for switchgrass are $88 t−1 DM in Missouri to $144 t−1 DM in Minnesota. In the high‐cost scenario, the lowest cost for miscanthus is $85 t−1 DM and for switchgrass is $118 t−1 DM, both in Missouri. These two scenarios differ in their assumptions about ease of establishing the perennial crops, nutrient requirements and harvesting costs and losses. The differences in the breakeven prices across states and across crops are mainly driven by bioenergy and row crop yields per hectare. Our results suggest that while high yields per unit of land of bioenergy crops are critical for the competitiveness of bioenergy feedstocks, the yields of the row crops they seek to displace are also an important consideration. Even high yielding crops, such as miscanthus, are likely to be economically attractive only in some locations in the Midwest given the high yields of corn and soybean in the region.
abstract_zh: 本研究将生物物理模型与针对县级的经济分析相结合，计算能源作物生产的盈亏平衡价格，以评估美国中西部地区生物燃料生产的生物物理和经济潜力。本研究考虑的能源作物包括一种芒草基因型（Miscanthus×giganteus）以及柳枝稷（Panicum virgatum）的Cave-in-Rock品种。估计中西部各州芒草的平均峰值生物量产量为每公顷每年7至48公吨干物质（t DM ha−1 yr−1），而柳枝稷为每公顷每年10至16公吨干物质。除明尼苏达州和威斯康星州因土壤温度低而芒草产量可能较低外，芒草的平均产量比柳枝稷高出两倍以上。我们发现，在低成本情景下，芒草生产的盈亏平衡价格（包括作物生产成本和土地机会成本）从密苏里州的每吨干物质53美元到明尼苏达州的153美元不等。柳枝稷的相应成本则从密苏里州的每吨干物质88美元到明尼苏达州的144美元不等。在高成本情景下，芒草的最低成本为每吨干物质85美元，柳枝稷为118美元，二者均出现在密苏里州。这两种情景在多年生作物建立的难易程度、养分需求以及收获成本和损失等假设方面存在差异。不同州和不同作物之间盈亏平衡价格的差异，主要由生物能源作物和行播作物的每公顷产量所驱动。我们的结果表明，虽然能源作物单位土地的高产量对于生物能源原料的竞争力至关重要，但其所替代的行播作物的产量也是一个重要考虑因素。即使是芒草这样的高产作物，鉴于该地区玉米和大豆的高产量，可能也只在中西部的部分地点具有经济吸引力。

title: Measurement of Environmental Efficiency and Productivity: A Cross Country Analysis
abstract: This paper measures environmental efficiency (EE) and environmental productivity (EP) and analyzes differences in these across countries. It explores the macro-economic factors that could explain these differences and whether these differences can be explained by income levels and by the degree of openness in these countries. The EE index is found to be almost steady over the period 1971-1992 for the annex-I countries, while its value is declining for non-annex-I countries over this period. The EP index increased over this period in both groups of countries. In the annex-I countries, EE increases after a certain threshold income level while it is decreasing for the non-annex-I countries. This study also finds that while the EP index increases with income in annex-I countries it is decreasing in the non-Annex-I countries. The degree of openness has a significant negative impact on EE and EP in both groups of countries.
abstract_zh: 本文测算了各国的环境效率（EE）和环境生产率（EP），并分析了这些指标在各国之间的差异。本文探讨了可能解释这些差异的宏观经济因素，以及这些差异能否由收入水平和经济开放程度来解释。1971–1992年间，附件一国家的EE指数基本保持稳定，而非附件一国家的该指数在此期间则有所下降。两组国家的EP指数在此期间均有所上升。在附件一国家中，EE在收入超过某一门槛水平后上升，而在非附件一国家中则下降。本研究还发现，附件一国家的EP指数随收入增加而上升，而非附件一国家则随收入增加而下降。开放程度对两组国家的EE和EP均有显著的负向影响。

title: Supply and Demand of Electricity in the Developing World
abstract: This paper reviews the literature that has sought to quantify the determinants of electricity demand and supply efficiency in developing countries. We examine the causal relationship between electricity consumption and economic growth, price and income elasticities of demand, and the barriers to adoption of energy-efficient equipment. We also examine the performance outcomes of economic policies affecting the electricity sector, including institutional reforms such as privatization and regulation. We find that electricity demand is driven by GDP, prices, income, the level and characteristics of economic activity/urbanization, and seasonal factors. The magnitude of their effects differs across countries, time periods, and studies even for the same country. These demand studies suffer from a number of limitations, including data availability and price distortions that limit responsiveness of demand to price signals. The literature is inconclusive on whether reforms, particularly privatization, improved supply efficiency. Effective regulation, competitive markets, and appropriate sequencing of reforms are important factors that influence the outcomes of privatization. There is a need for more quantitative analysis of the social welfare and distributional impacts of privatization of the electricity sector in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了量化发展中国家电力需求和供给效率决定因素的文献。我们考察了电力消费与经济增长之间的因果关系、需求的价格和收入弹性，以及采用节能设备的障碍。我们还考察了影响电力部门的经济政策的绩效结果，包括私有化和监管等制度改革。我们发现，电力需求受GDP、价格、收入、经济活动的水平与特征（城市化程度）以及季节性因素的驱动。这些影响的大小在不同国家、不同时期以及不同研究之间存在差异，即使是针对同一国家也是如此。这些需求研究存在若干局限，包括数据可得性以及价格扭曲，后者限制了需求对价格信号的反应。关于改革（尤其是私有化）是否提高了供给效率，文献尚无定论。有效的监管、竞争性市场以及改革的适当排序，是影响私有化结果的重要因素。仍需对发展中国家电力部门私有化的社会福利和分配影响进行更多的定量分析。

title: Sustainability of Food, Energy and Environment with Biofuels
abstract: Growing reliance on food-based biofuels has created considerable controversy about their impact on food prices and the environment and led to scepticism about their sustainability. This review describes the concept of sustainability in the context of biofuels and then discusses the factors affecting the economic viability of current and next-generation biofuels and their environmental and social sustainability. Cellulosic biofuels from dedicated energy crops offer considerable promise for reducing the competition for land and avoiding many of the negative environmental impacts associated with corn-ethanol. But the production of any type of biofuel is likely to involve trade-offs among the multi-dimensional aspects of sustainability. Technological innovation and policy incentives are needed to develop more sustainable biofuels and to guide the mix of feedstocks, their methods and locations of production.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料对粮食、能源与环境的可持续性。对以粮食为原料的生物燃料的日益依赖引发了广泛争议，涉及其对粮食价格和环境的影响，并使人们对其可持续性产生了怀疑。本综述阐述了生物燃料语境下可持续性的概念，继而讨论了影响当前及下一代生物燃料经济可行性，以及其环境与社会可持续性的诸多因素。来自专门能源作物的纤维素生物燃料，在减少对土地的竞争以及避免玉米乙醇所伴随的诸多负面环境影响方面，展现出可观的前景。然而，任何类型生物燃料的生产都可能涉及可持续性多维度之间的权衡。技术创新和政策激励对于开发更具可持续性的生物燃料，以及引导原料组合、生产方法和生产地点的选择，是必要的。

title: Voluntary Pollution Reduction Programs, Environmental Management, and Environmental Performance: An Empirical Study
abstract: This paper examines, empirically, the mechanism by which a voluntary pollution reduction program (VPR) achieves pollution reductions. We find that participation in the 33/50 program, the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s first VPR, spurred the adoption of total quality environmental management (TQEM), an environmental management system that views pollution as a quality defect to be continuously reduced through the development of products and processes that minimize waste generation at source. We find in turn that TQEM had a significant negative effect on 33/50 releases and that 33/50 participation produced additional direct pollution reduction benefits both during and after the program years. abstract_zh: 本文从实证角度考察了自愿性污染减排（VPR）计划实现污染减排的机制。我们发现，美国环境保护署首个自愿性污染减排计划“33/50计划”（33/50 Program）的参与，推动了全面质量环境管理（TQEM）的采用。TQEM是一种环境管理体系，它将污染视为一种质量缺陷，通过开发产品和工艺来从源头减少废物产生，从而持续地降低污染。我们进一步发现，TQEM对33/50计划下的排放量有显著的负向影响，并且参与33/50计划在计划实施期间和之后都带来了额外的直接污染减排效益。（JEL C23, Q58）

Striving To Be Green: The Adoption Of Total Quality Environmental Management
abstract: Many firms are undertaking environment-friendly organizational change by applying the philosophy of total quality management with its emphasis on reducing waste and increasing efficiency. Their objective is to improve their management of pollution and increase customer satisfaction. This article investigates the factors that lead to total quality environmental management (TQEM) by large firms. We find that internal considerations stemming from a firm's technical capability, size (absolute and relative to competing firms), extent of operations and volume of past emissions are strongly associated with the TQEM adoption decision. The first four factors are proxies for the firm's costs and capabilities of adopting TQEM while the fifth factor is related to the benefits from increasing efficiency and waste reduction, and thus proxies for internally generated demand for TQEM. The desire to improve a firm's image with customers, earning good-will with regulators and the anticipation of future regulations do not appear to be associated with the adoption of TQEM. Thus, this article's main conclusion is that the adoption of TQEM is associated mostly with internal factors and motives.
abstract_zh: 许多企业正通过应用全面质量管理的理念进行有利于环境的组织变革，该理念强调减少浪费和提高效率。其目标是改善污染管理并提高客户满意度。本文考察了大型企业采用全面质量环境管理（TQEM）的影响因素。我们发现，企业的技术能力、规模（绝对规模及相对于竞争对手的规模）、经营范围以及过去的排放量等内部因素与TQEM的采纳决策密切相关。前四个因素代理了企业采纳TQEM的成本和能力，第五个因素则与提高效率和减少浪费所带来的收益有关，因而代理了企业内部产生的TQEM需求。提升企业在客户心目中的形象、赢得监管者的好感以及预期未来的监管要求，似乎都与TQEM的采纳无关。因此，本文的主要结论是：TQEM的采纳主要与内部因素和动机相关。

title: Welfare Effects and Unintended Consequences of Ethanol Subsidies
Welfare Impacts of Alternative Public Policies for Agricultural Pollution Control in an Open Economy: A General Equilibrium Framework
abstract: A general equilibrium approach is used to evaluate the welfare impacts of alternative policies for reducing agricultural pollution in an open economy with preexisting distortions caused by income taxes and agricultural subsidies. The policies examined here include the removal of distortionary agricultural subsidies. We find that even though these distortions are small compared to others in the economy, removing them and imposing nitrogen reduction subsidies and/or output taxes can enhance welfare and reduce nitrogen pollution; thereby leading to a substantial double dividend. The relative efficiency of the alternative policies examined here depends on the level of the nitrogen reduction target.
abstract_zh: 本文采用一般均衡方法，评估了在一个开放经济体中，减少农业污染的不同政策对福利的影响，该经济体中存在由所得税和农业补贴造成的既有扭曲。所考察的政策包括取消具有扭曲性的农业补贴。我们发现，尽管这些扭曲相较于经济中的其他扭曲而言规模较小，但取消它们，并实施减氮补贴和/或产出税，可以提升福利并减少氮污染，从而产生显著的双重红利。本文所考察的各项替代政策的相对效率取决于氮减排目标的高低。

Motivations for Voluntary Environmental Management
abstract: This article examines the motivations for firms to participate in voluntary environmental programs and to adopt environmental management practices using data gathered from a survey conducted in 2005 of facilities located in Oregon operating in six industrial sectors. It is one of the first studies of voluntary environmental management to include small‐, medium‐, and large‐sized facilities as well as to include both privately and publicly owned facilities. In particular, we examine the effects of both external factors such as regulatory, consumer, and investor pressures, and internal factors such as technical and resource capacity, in influencing voluntary environmental behavior. The intent is to describe potential influences that have implications for designing and implementing private and public policies that foster effective voluntary environmental management by firms. We find that larger facilities are more likely to participate in more voluntary environmental programs, but are likely to adopt more environmental management practices only if environmental issues are of significant concern to them. Presence of an R&D department stimulates the adoption of more environmental management practices, particularly if environmental issues are of significant concern to the facility, but does not have a statistically significant impact on participation in voluntary programs. We also find that while regulatory pressures are significant in motivating participation in voluntary programs and adoption of environmental management practices, competitive pressures are only important in motivating the former. Pressure from final good consumers or from investors in publicly traded facilities is not found to have a significant influence on voluntary environmental behavior of facilities in this study.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2005年在俄勒冈州对六个工业部门设施开展的调查数据，考察了企业参与自愿性环境计划并采用环境管理措施的动机。这是首批将中小型与大型设施，以及私营与公有设施均纳入样本的自愿性环境管理研究之一。具体而言，我们考察了监管、消费者和投资者压力等外部因素，以及技术和资源能力等内部因素，对自愿性环境行为的影响。本文旨在描述可能的影响因素，以便为设计和实施促进企业有效开展自愿性环境管理的公共与私人政策提供参考。我们发现，规模较大的设施更有可能参与更多的自愿性环境计划，但只有当环境问题对其而言非常重要时，才更有可能采用更多的环境管理措施。设有研发部门会促进企业采用更多的环境管理措施，尤其是在环境问题对该设施而言非常重要的情况下，但对参与自愿性计划并无统计上显著的影响。我们还发现，监管压力在促使企业参与自愿性计划和采用环境管理措施方面均具有显著作用，而竞争压力仅在促使企业参与自愿性计划方面具有重要作用。本研究未发现来自终端产品消费者或上市设施投资者的压力对设施的自愿性环境行为有显著影响。

abstract: We develop a water allocation and irrigation technology adoption model under the prior appropriation doctrine with asymmetric information among heterogeneous farmers and between farmers and water authorities. We find that adverse selection reduces the adoption of modern irrigation technology. We also show that even with asymmetric information, incentives for water trade exist and lead to additional technology adoption with gains to all parties. This suggests that under asymmetric information, a thin secondary market improves the allocation of water resources and induces additional adoption of modern irrigation technologies.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在优先占用原则下的水资源分配与灌溉技术采纳模型，该模型考虑了异质性农户之间以及农户与水务管理部门之间的信息不对称。我们发现，逆向选择会降低现代灌溉技术的采纳率。我们还表明，即使存在信息不对称，水权交易的激励依然存在，并会带来额外的技术采纳，且各方均可获益。这表明，在信息不对称的情况下，一个规模不大的二级市场能够改善水资源配置，并促使更多农户采纳现代灌溉技术。

title: Is Geographical Targeting Cost-Effective? The Case of the Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program in Illinois
abstract: This paper uses economic, hydrologic, and GIS modeling to assess the effectiveness of the Illinois Conservation Reserve Enhancement Program in the Lower Sangamon watershed. Our results show that for a representative five-year storm event, the acres currently enrolled in the program result in a 12% reduction in sediment loading, which is below the program goal of 20% and four times the least-cost solution. We also analyze the design of alternative rental payment instruments for improving the cost-effectiveness of geographical targeting for land retirement. Policy implications for the characteristics of the land parcels that should be targeted for enrollment in the program are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文运用经济学、水文学和地理信息系统（GIS）建模，评估了伊利诺伊州保护性储备增强计划（CREP）在下桑加蒙流域的成效。我们的结果显示，对于一次具有代表性的五年一遇暴雨事件，目前参与该计划的土地面积可使泥沙负荷减少12%，低于该计划20%的目标，也是最低成本方案减排量的四倍。我们还分析了不同租金支付工具的设计，以提高土地退出的地理定向的成本效益。本文讨论了该计划中应优先纳入的地块特征所具有的政策含义。

title: Natural Resource Damage Assessment Methods: Lessons in Simplicity from State Trustees
abstract: When natural resource damages are caused by releases of hazardous materials into the environment, government trustees must conduct Natural Resource Damage Assessments (NRDAs) to support claims to recover the value of lost or damaged resources. This article sets forth theoretical arguments that support efforts to develop unbiased simplified NRDA methods for use by government trustees and proposes a set of criteria that can be used to evaluate the quality of any such simplified method. The authors then describe the simplified methods being used by five states across the country, affording academic economists a rare view of the kinds of methods state agencies use in‐house. The article evaluates those methods against the criteria set forth and discusses the potential of other nonstate‐specific simplified NRDA methods (benefit transfer and Type A models) to do the job better. The new framework established can guide future research to design simplified methods that are less biased than the simplified methods currently in use by some states without compromising ease of implementation. abstract: This paper develops a behavioral model of farmer decision making to analyze the incentives for adoption of a technology that provides information about spatial variability in nutrient availability and enables variable rate application of fertilizers. It examines the implications of uncertainty about the accuracy of the technology on input application and adoption decisions. Risk aversion and uncertainty can lead to the imposition of a risk premium on input use, which create incentives to over or under apply fertilizers. This influences not only the incentives to adopt the technology but also the impact of adoption on pollution. High spatial variability mitigates the disincentives for adoption even if fixed costs are high and farm size is small but the extent to which this occurs depends on the degree of risk aversion and uncertainty. These results have implications for the design and effectiveness of cost–share subsidies to induce adoption and reduce over application of fertilizers.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个农户决策的行为模型，用以分析采纳一项技术的激励因素，该技术可提供关于养分有效性空间变异的信息，并支持化肥的变量施用。文章考察了技术精度不确定性对投入品施用及采纳决策的影响。风险厌恶与不确定性可能导致对投入品使用施加风险溢价，从而激励农户过量或不足施肥。这不仅影响农户采纳该技术的动机，也影响采纳对污染的作用。即使固定成本较高且农场规模较小，较高的空间变异性也能缓解采纳的负向激励，但这一效应的强弱取决于风险厌恶程度和不确定性程度。这些结果对于设计和评估成本分摊补贴的效果具有启示意义，该补贴旨在诱导农户采纳该技术并减少化肥的过量施用。

title: Environmental Costs and Benefits of Genetically Modified Crops: Implications for Regulatory Strategies
abstract: This article sets forth a framework for evaluating the environmental costs and benefits associated with agricultural genetically modified organisms (GMOs), including impacts on plants, humans, animals, and the environment at large. The authors build on this knowledge to explore how and why GMOs should be regulated, highlighting the need for policy makers to bear in mind that genetically modified seeds might substitute for traditional agricultural practices which themselves have detrimental impacts on the environment. To guide regulation formation, the authors present a review of the literature in environmental economics on optimal and second-best regulation, where the latter is used in the face of real-world complications. They then evaluate how current regulations measure up to those theoretical ideals. Finally, the authors provide some insight into what GMO crop regulation might accomplish by reviewing the evidence on the effects of pesticide regulations.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，用于评估与农业转基因生物（GMO）相关的环境成本与效益，包括对植物、人类、动物以及整体环境的影响。作者在此基础上探讨了转基因生物应如何以及为何需要监管，并强调政策制定者需要注意，转基因种子可能替代那些本身对环境有负面影响的传统农业做法。为指导监管制度的制定，作者回顾了环境经济学中关于最优监管与次优监管的文献，其中次优监管适用于存在现实复杂性的情形。随后，作者评估了现行监管与这些理论理想之间的差距。最后，作者通过回顾农药监管效果的证据，进一步探讨了转基因作物监管可能取得的成效。

title: Investment in Site-Specific Crop Management under Uncertainty: Implications for Nitrate Pollution Control and Environmental Policy
abstract: This paper applies an option-pricing model to analyze the impact of uncertainty about output prices and expectations of declining fixed costs on the optimal timing of investment in site-specific crop management (SSCM). It also analyzes the extent to which the level of spatial variability in soil conditions can mitigate the value of waiting to invest in SSCM and influence the optimal timing of adoption and create a preference for custom hiring rather than owner purchase of equipment. Numerical simulations show that while the net present value (NPV) rule predicts that immediate adoption is profitable under most of the soil conditions considered here, recognition of the option value of investment indicates that it is preferable to delay investment in SSCM for at least 3 years unless average soil quality is high and the variability in soil quality and fertility is high. The use of the option value approach reveals that the value of waiting to invest in SSCM raises the cost-share subsidy rates required to induce immediate adoption above the levels indicated by the NPV rule.
abstract_zh: 本文运用期权定价模型，分析了产出价格的不确定性以及对固定成本下降的预期，如何影响特定地块作物管理（SSCM）投资的最优时机。文章还分析了土壤条件的空间变异程度在多大程度上可以削弱等待投资的价值，并影响SSCM采纳的最优时机，以及是否形成了偏好雇用定制服务而非自购设备的倾向。数值模拟结果表明，虽然净现值（NPV）法则预测，在所考虑的大多数土壤条件下立即采纳都是有利可图的，但考虑投资的期权价值后，除非平均土壤质量较高且土壤质量和肥力的变异性也较高，否则推迟至少3年投资更为可取。期权价值方法表明，等待投资SSCM的价值会使诱导立即采纳所需的成本分摊补贴率高于净现值法则所示的水平。

abstract: This paper explores the sources and magnitude of energy-inefficiency in the electricity generating sector in India and its implications for carbon emissions from this sector. An econometric methodology is developed to disaggregate and quantify the contribution of technical and institutional factors to this inefficiency. The analysis demonstrates the potential for institutional and economic policy reforms that provide incentives for the adoption of efficiency-enhancing production practices to reduce carbon emissions while increasing net electricity generation, even with the existing capital equipment.

abstract: Sustainable agriculture is prescribed as a policy approach that maximizes economic benefits while maintaining environmental quality. It is argued that this approach is human capital–intensive and encourages new scientific developments. To attain sustainability, economic incentives for the development and adoption of precision technologies (with minimal residues that cause environmental damage) have to be developed. Taxation and tradeable permits are desirable policies to attain first–best solutions; however, when heterogeneity and lack–of–information problems are significant, alternative institutions have to be developed. The paper presents and discusses such institutions.
abstract_zh: 可持续农业被视为一种政策路径，其目标是在维持环境质量的同时实现经济效益最大化。有观点认为，这一路径具有人力资本密集的特点，并能促进科学的新发展。为实现可持续性，必须建立经济激励机制，以推动精准技术（残留物最少、对环境损害最小）的研发与采纳。在理想情形下，征税和可交易许可证是实现第一最优解的可取政策；然而，当异质性和信息不足问题较为突出时，则必须建立替代性制度。本文提出并讨论了此类制度。
